definitions.explanation: A gate or barrier at airports, train stations, stadiums, or other facilities that controls entry and exit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{搭乗|とうじょう}→搭乗：06200_toujou⟧ゲート⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: I head to the boarding gate.

examples.japanese: ゲート⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|あ}く→開く：00689_aku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please wait until the gate opens.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{搭乗|とうじょう}→搭乗：06200_toujou⟧ゲート⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧になった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦{移動|いどう}した→移動する：22430_idousuru⟧。
examples.english: The boarding gate at the airport was changed, so I hurried to the new one.

notes:
ゲート comes from English "gate" and is used primarily for controlled entry/exit points at facilities.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{搭乗|とうじょう}→搭乗：06200_toujou⟧ゲート: boarding gate (airport)
- ⟦{改札|かいさつ}→改札：04120_kaisatsu⟧ゲート: ticket gate (train station)
- ⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧ゲート: entrance gate
- ⟦スタート→スタート：11053_sutaato⟧ゲート: starting gate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧: gate (traditional, for buildings, temples, etc.)
- ⟦{改札|かいさつ}→改札：04120_kaisatsu⟧: ticket gate (at train stations, more common than ゲート in this context)
- ゲート is typically used for modern facilities like airports and stadiums, while ⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧ is for traditional architecture.
